title: iPhone held by cd-roll-ca, unused for 5 min while 1 job waits

messages.text:

Queued for it: fix-nav-morph.
cd-roll-ca: run your phone part now, or release the lease (node tools/lock.mjs release iphone --owner cd-roll-ca) so the next one can start, or say here why it waits. Desk (mgmt-ops-10): please make sure the phone is used.
